headline: Enciso earns Ipswich a point after Forest take early lead

sentences.text: Ipswich Town had to recover from an early setback at Portman Road, but Julio Enciso’s 41st-minute equaliser secured a 1–1 draw with Nottingham Forest.
The result gave both sides a point, and Ipswich finished the evening 9th in the Premier League with 10 points from 8 matches.
Forest had arrived 19th with 5 points from 7 games, while Ipswich began 10th on 9 points.
Neco Williams put the visitors ahead in the 13th minute, assisted by Daniel Muñoz, and Ipswich had to wait until the 41st minute to get back on level terms.
The teams went into half-time at 1–1, and neither found a second-half goal.
Ipswich made 5 substitutions across the second half, while Forest made 3, but the score stayed unchanged.
The numbers show how much pressure Ipswich had to withstand: Forest had 17 shots to Ipswich’s 7 and an xG of 2.29 against 0.46.
Forest also had 5 corners to Ipswich’s 0, while Ipswich goalkeeper made 3 saves compared with 2 at the other end.
Possession was nearly even, with Ipswich at 49.4% and Forest at 50.6%, and Ipswich completed 486 passes to Forest’s 480.
For Ipswich supporters, there is encouragement in the side’s resilience, though the shot and xG gap makes clear the team had to ride its luck.
Ipswich’s previous 5 league games had brought 6 points, one more than Forest’s 4 from their last 5.
Ipswich ended above Forest in the table, with 10 points to Forest’s 6.
